decision_scope: Whether to justify a complete 2495-locus MDD2025 trait-only sensitivity screen; never family promotion
comparison: Same preselected pilot loci in the frozen canonical MDD univariate aggregate
required_conditions: All 111 fixed pilot loci have receipt-bound outcomes
Source, locus, reference and software hashes match the fixed pilot manifest
No PLACO or downstream frailty association outcome used for candidate selection or decision
interpretation_limit: The five-per-chromosome plus MHC-control pilot is diagnostic and is not an unbiased estimate of the full-family NOT_RUN fraction. A positive pilot only authorizes a complete trait-only screen under a separate sensitivity protocol.
